calculation.description: Ranks assets by net 30-session return relative to the total absolute daily path traveled; higher values identify smooth, persistent directional trends. The one-session lag prevents look-ahead.

validation.regime_notes: Full-sample 20-day paper IC and ICIR pass benchmark gates. Regime IC/ICIR: 2026+ 0.010568/0.030036 (below ICIR gate), 2027+ 0.030288/0.097059 (passes), 2028+ 0.159189/0.595268 (passes strongly). Results are recent-regime concentrated and uncertainty is material with 15 instruments per date.
validation.provenance: Executed scripts/miner_2_20281005_path_efficiency.py on 2028-10-05 using all 15 tradable instruments; observation-only macro series excluded. Pairwise aligned signal scan found max absolute library correlation 1.0 with scripts/miner_2_20280629_path_efficiency_momentum_30_signal.csv, so this factor should receive no independent ensemble weight until deduplication review.
